The Waldorf Astoria brand (Waldorf Astoria Hotels & Resorts) is owned by Hilton Worldwide, where it serves as the flagship luxury brand [d2]. The physical Waldorf Astoria New York building, however, has a separate ownership history: Hilton sold it to China-based Anbang Insurance Group for $1.95 billion in 2014 [d1][d5], retaining a 100-year management contract [d7]. When Anbang went bankrupt in 2020, Dajia Insurance Group took over ownership of the New York property [d1][d8]. Separately, the Washington D.C. Waldorf Astoria occupies a government-owned Old Post Office building whose lease was sold by the Trump Organization in May 2022 to a Miami-based investor fund [d6]. The New York hotel, managed by Hilton under its Waldorf Astoria brand, is expected to reopen in spring 2025 following an extensive renovation [d4][d7].
